title: Chapter 1331
text:
Beyond Grade A Association headquarters, Planet Finn.

Today was the first regular meeting after the three Universal Civilizations gave in. All the Beyond Grade A members were present early. No one was not curious about what agreement Black Star had reached with the three Universal Civilizations and were waiting for the president to give them an explanation.

"This is really sudden. Black Star completed the peace talks with the three Universal Civilizations without a word. I didn't receive any news at all," Kasuyi complained.

"I wonder what agreement the president reached with the three Universal Civilizations in private? With Black Star's personality, we shouldn't be the ones at a disadvantage, "Kant said with an uncertain tone.

Of course, no one present believed the announcement made by the three Universal Civilizations. They all knew that Black Star must have done some insider trading in private, but no one had found out what was going on.

"By the way, Ames, you're so close to Black Star. Did he tell you anything?" Sisko turned and asked.

"He didn't tell me," Ames turned to Hella and said with a smile, "but Hella might know."

"… I'm not sure. I haven't seen him recently." Hella pursed her lips and shook her head.

Everyone whispered to each other for a while, and Han Xiao's remote projection finally landed on the main seat. He looked around and smiled.

"Since everyone is here, let's get straight to the point. The main reason I gathered everyone here today is to tell you the agreement I reached with the three Universal Civilizations, as well as the next step of the association."

Han Xiao glanced around. Seeing that everyone was listening to him attentively, he continued.

"The three Universal Civilizations agreed to a few of my conditions. They've decided to lift the blockade and make up for our losses during this period. They'll also give us additional compensation. In addition, they'll recognize the official status of the Beyond Grade A Association and enjoy the same rights as the advanced civilizations. This will be written into the galactic law. At the same time, we'll get a highly autonomous territory at the edge of the explored universe. That's about it."

As soon as he finished, the entire place was so quiet that one could hear a pin drop.

The Beyond Grade A members present were shocked and looked at Han Xiao in disbelief.

It was not that this agreement was bad but that it was too good. They did not expect that Black Star would be able to obtain such ridiculous benefits that even the three Universal Civilizations were willing to accept.

A normal truce was still within the range of understanding, but the three Universal Civilizations were not giving in at all but surrendering. Only when someone had their reproductive organs pinched by someone else would they compromise to this extent!

Originally, everyone thought that it would be good enough if the three Universal Civilizations were willing to give them some compensation, but they did not expect such a surprise. With this, the problems that had been troubling the association were mostly solved, and they had much less to worry about.

"How did you do it?" Kasuyi couldn't help but ask.

Han Xiao vaguely glanced at the Beyond Grade As of the Supercluster and said, "I know that everyone is curious about the reason why the three Universal Civilizations gave in, but this matter is rather complicated, and we don't have a definite answer yet. Furthermore, these benefits are not given for free. It's part of the deal, and the price is that we have to help the three Universal Civilizations at certain times."

Hearing this, everyone looked at each other.

Seeing this, Han Xiao spread his hands. "If you have any opinions, you can raise them. The foundation of our association's existence is to respect the attitude of all members. If you feel that it's not suitable, we can discuss it again."

Beiger immediately coughed and said, "I think it's not bad. After all, we revivors have already died once. We can't enjoy the Sanctum Revival, so we don't have to take the risk of fighting. Of course, it's a good thing."

Hearing this, many of the revivors nodded. Oathkeeper's lies were deeply rooted in their hearts. In their opinion, if they died again, they could only go to the Underworld and live a lowly life.

I thought I could start a massacre and teach the three Universal Civilizations an unforgettable lesson to repay them for what they did to me back then. I didn't expect that after a few hundred years, the three Universal Civilizations would become a bunch of cowards … Black Star, you too, what's there to negotiate? The three Universal Civilizations chose to give in, so they must be in trouble. We should beat them when they're down. You didn't even seize such a good opportunity. I thought you were a ruthless person, but I was wrong about you! "

"Hmm?"

Han Xiao raised his brows and let out a nasal sound.

Dillon snorted, his tone not showing any weakness.

"I didn't expect you to not be the kind of guy I thought you were, but a wise man full of righteousness, foresight, and rationality. You deserve to be our leader."

"Hmm …" Han Xiao nodded in satisfaction, and his nasal voice deepened.

Everyone immediately looked away in disdain, ignoring Dillon's voice.

Kasuyi came out to smooth things over and said with a smile, "These conditions are all surprises, so no one has any objections. However, Black Star, the three Universal Civilizations have only expressed their willingness to stop and make peace. They haven't acknowledged our independence yet. Are you sure they will fulfill the agreement? I still don't think they will compromise so easily. "

"There's basically no problem, but we'll have to wait for a while."

Han Xiao shook his head.

He had already asked Herberlon to talk to the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations to increase his persuasiveness. When the three Universal Civilizations had some results in their actual exploration, it was time to fulfill the agreement.

Furthermore, this matter had caused an uproar and was currently in the limelight. The three Universal Civilizations planned to deal with it coldly for a period of time and only announce this matter after the heat of public opinion had passed.

"I hope so." Kasuyi nodded and asked curiously, "Then what's the next development path of the association? Do you have any ideas?"

Han Xiao shook his head. "Everyone, recover your strength first and continue to accumulate forces. As for the future, we'll talk about it after the three Universal Civilizations fulfill the agreement."

He remembered another idea he had in the past. When their political status was recognized and the autonomous territory was in their hands, the association's reputation among the Supers would rise to a new level. Perhaps they could create a country that belonged solely to the Supers and absorb the free Supers of the entire universe. The current association would then become the ruling parliament of the country.

On one hand, it was to consider their future development. They had to expand the size of the organization and recruit more people. As the 'seedlings' of the Beyond Grade As, the more Supers there were, the better. On the other hand, it was to ensure their independence. Ordinary Supers would have many worries living under the jurisdiction of the three Universal Civilizations. If they had a new place to go, they would have a choice, and there would always be people who were willing to become residents here.

Furthermore, the conflict between the ordinary people and the Supers was getting more and more intense. Everyone did not see eye to eye with each other. Perhaps it was not bad to give the Supers a chance to live separately. It might be good for everyone.

Of course, the three Universal Civilizations would definitely not be happy to see this. Before the threat of the World Tree erupted, Han Xiao would not consider taking action.

As long as it's a Super, no race will reject them … Hmm, why does this behavior seem a little familiar?

Han Xiao scratched his head.

If he remembered correctly, this idea was a little like the character in a comic that was still serialized in his previous life. It should be the 'auntie' who built the World of Nations.

Then what am I, the big boss?

Han Xiao threw these random thoughts out of his mind and continued to discuss business with everyone.

After talking for more than an hour, the meeting finally ended. Everyone left with excitement and relaxation.

Han Xiao deactivated the remote projection. Just as he returned to his office, Philip appeared.

"Master, hum … You have a high-level encrypted message. It's from the Supercluster Alliance, hum …"

"Oh, looks like they can't hold it in anymore."

Han Xiao opened the message and took a look. It was a message from the Supercluster Alliance inviting him to a meeting.

He was not surprised. The association had originally cooperated with the Supercluster Alliance to fight against the three Universal Civilizations. Now that the three Universal Civilizations and the association had stopped fighting each other, the Supercluster Alliance, as the 'third party', was in a difficult position.

Furthermore, the Supercluster Beyond Grade As who had participated in the meeting earlier must have sent the agreement back. The Supercluster Alliance was definitely anxious, afraid that the association and the three Universal Civilizations would work together again. Thus, they hurriedly came to test his attitude.

…

Ten minutes later, in the meeting room of the Supercluster Alliance, the various leaders gathered and sat upright.

Han Xiao's remote projection appeared in the room, and he immediately felt everyone's gazes.

The Star Arc Civilization's leader said with a deep voice, "Black Star, we agreed to work together to fight against the three Universal Civilizations. What's going on now?"

Han Xiao shrugged. "The goal of the struggle is peace. The association has already achieved its goal, so there's no need to continue fighting against the three Universal Civilizations. This is good for the association."

"What about our alliance?"

Han Xiao calmly said, "Our previous alliance had a total of four conditions. Other than the first condition, which is to fight against the three Universal Civilizations, the other three are two-way resource sharing and cooperation. We can continue to cooperate in the future."

The Star Arc Civilization's leader could not help but ask, "Then, what if the three Universal Civilizations have something to say? Will you break the alliance because of this?"

"Since the three Universal Civilizations have admitted that the association can keep the Virtual Virus Technology, they've admitted that no one has the right to interfere with the association's internal affairs. Which galactic law did I violate by forming an alliance with you? So what if they have something to say? " Han Xiao shrugged. "Maybe we can change the first agreement and change the condition of joining forces against the three Universal Civilizations to that the association cannot take the initiative to attack the Supercluster Civilizations other than counterattacking. At the same time, the Sanctum Revival quota I promised you will still be effective."

Hearing this, everyone was a little surprised. They were prepared for Black Star to turn against them, but from the looks of it, Black Star seemed to be very easy to talk to.

Han Xiao smiled and said, "To put it bluntly, we don't trust the three Universal Civilizations, so we need to leave a way out. Therefore, we're willing to maintain a good relationship with the Supercluster Alliance. When the association was blocked, it was you guys who lent a helping hand. Personally, I'm also willing to continue cooperating, so I still have this bit of credibility. "

"I see …"

The Star Arc Civilization's leader was relieved.

Although it made it seem like an affair, this result was barely acceptable. The main thing was that Black Star did not intend to go back on his Sanctum Revival quota, so this was quite good.

So what if we're two-timing? At least we still have the right to be stepped on!

As long as it's comfortable, we can even accept a spare tire!

…

After the parties involved expressed their opinions one after another, even if all kinds of conspiracy theories ran rampant, the situation quickly calmed down, and the galactic residents and the various large organizations slowly returned to their normal lives.

The blockade was lifted, and the various channels of the association were reopened one after another, gradually returning to normal business. However, the plan to integrate the black market did not stop, and it was still carried out by the players.

Something big happened every day, and the lives of ordinary people had to continue. The dispute between the three Universal Civilizations and the association also gradually became the topic of conversation after meals, no longer being talked about every day.

However, under the surface of peace, undercurrents were surging. The three Universal Civilizations were secretly preparing for war and investigating. This set of wormhole data left behind by EsGod was named 'World Tree Passage'.

With Han Xiao's reminder, the three Universal Civilizations were very careful in their exploration. So far, they had not encountered any life from the World Tree Civilization.

At the same time, the three Universal Civilizations listened to Han Xiao's suggestion and organized a joint expedition army, intending to enter the depths of the secondary dimensions to search for the so-called World Tree's main body.

Secondary Dimension World, dynasty outpost.

A huge expedition fleet was gathered here, undergoing the last inspection before departure. The dock was filled with soldiers of the three Universal Civilizations with serious expressions.

Han Xiao stood on the dock and watched this scene.

Harrison stood to the side with his backpack on his back, at a loss as to what to do.

He said weakly, "Your Excellency Black Star, what is this fleet looking for? Why do I have to participate …"

"To find something related to the fate of the explored universe."

Han Xiao patted his shoulder.

"Do I have to go …" Harrison was about to cry.

He was still young and was not the old explorer from his previous life. Furthermore, the World Tree War had not broken out yet, so he could not ignore life and death.

An expedition to the depths of the secondary dimensions was not an easy mission. Along the way, they would have to pass through countless strange secondary dimensions. Who knew what kind of situation they would encounter? If they did not deal with it properly, they would suffer heavy losses. Furthermore, communication was not convenient. They would be like a lone army that could not communicate with the rear.

"What are you afraid of? Didn't I leave you a lot of equipment? If you encounter danger, they will be enough to protect you. If not, didn't you bring a set of Lord's Avatar and a Throne? I can teleport over at any time."

Han Xiao patted his head.

"I'm afraid that I won't be able to call you in time before I die." Harrison looked dejected. "Furthermore, there are so many people participating. There's no point in adding me, right?"

Han Xiao was helpless and could not answer.

In his previous life, Harrison had discovered the main body of the World Tree, but this time, who knew if the Goddess of Luck would favor him.

Furthermore, the main body of the World Tree was not without protection. The surrounding secondary dimensions were filled with countless Spawn Races, which were extremely dangerous. When the fleet discovered the other party, the World Tree also discovered them.

However, if they could not find the main body of the World Tree, their chances of winning were slim. Sending the expedition team in advance was already a step ahead.

Han Xiao was currently the only outsider cooperating with the three Universal Civilizations to explore the World Tree. Other than Harrison, he had also chosen some trustworthy people to participate in the first batch of secondary dimensions expedition team. Most of them were mechanical lives, with some Black Spirit Race members mixed in.

After comforting Harrison for a while, the expedition fleet was finally ready.

Harrison looked back three times with every step, but in the end, he still stepped onto the spaceship bravely.

With the roar of the secondary dimension's dedicated engine, the joint expedition fleet slowly took off, turning into a flash of light and disappearing from everyone's sight, heading toward the unknown future.
